title: Answer engine
content: An answer engine is a search tool that responds to a question with a written answer and links to its sources in place of a list of pages.

meta.aliases:
AI answer engine
AI search engine
meta.why: A reader can get what they need from the answer and stop there. Your brand is seen as a cited source or a named option before any click.
meta.example: A person asks which accounting tools support multiple currencies and receives a short written comparison with links to four sources.
meta.check: Ask one buyer question in two answer engines and record which sources each one links and which brands each one names.
meta.limitation: The label covers products that work in different ways, and a result from one answer engine does not predict the result from another.
meta.sources: Perplexity: what is an answer engine | https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/10354917-what-is-an-answer-engine-and-how-does-perplexity-work-as-one | Vendor documentation
